notes.title: Witchcrafty upcoming!
notes.notes:
Witchcrafty is a metroidvania-platformer that immerses you in a world of magic. Everything you expect from a fairy game, but with a touch of weirdness. A little witch with an unhealthy craving for explosions. Suspicious magic cat. Giant mushrooms trying to kick you.
Stay in touch and add game to wishlist, so you won't miss demo and game release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1122280/Witchcrafty/

notes.title: 1.3 UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33382161/93c8c627e414cd6659d06cdc5f8712e3eddfa3b0.png[/img]

Here comes third major update of Awesome Pea.

+ Achievements entirely reworked.
+ New objects and sprites (like trolley on cave levels)
+ UI fix on various screen resolutions
+ Bugfixes
+ And one more pea pixel was redrawn

notes.title: 1.2 PATCH
notes.notes:
Good news, everyone!

Here comes the second patch!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33382161/6d6a9b7726114bbb9d19f617d7a830304936a55d.png[/img]

+ now you can disable tube- and crt-effect in settings menu
+ controller movement improved - now you can use both left stick and d-pad in game and map menu ^_^
+ balance improvements on cave-levels
+ another one pea pixel was redrawn

notes.title: 1.1 PATCH
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I have tried to fix the most major issues, so...here comes the first patch :)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33382161/62417b0c334fb0375880ad6f3b1486b463d2a2eb.png[/img]

+ level music will not disappear anymore
+ greed is good i/ii achievements fixed - now you need 500 gold in coins and 5000 gold in gems ^)
+ menu music will not end (never)
+ block collision fixes
+ redrawn one pea pixel
